title: After upgrade to Android 9.1.0  BluCon no pairing with bluetooth
symptom: After upgrading to Android 9.1.0, BluCon does not pair with Bluetooth. The issue occurs on a HUAWEI Mate 20 Lite and a Huawei P30 Lite. Hard reset, clear cache, all permissions etc. do not help. The user tested with LinkBluCon which works without problems, but xDrip cannot get readings from BluCon.
